13-14.label: Foundation
13-14.emphasis: ~70% technical: ball mastery, first touch, 1v1, SSGs; introduce heading & GK streams

15-16.label: Development
15-16.emphasis: Technical + tactical principles, position-specific work, supervised strength intro

17-19.label: Performance
17-19.emphasis: Position specialisation, game model, set pieces, physical loading, senior-football mirror

drills.name: Ball Mastery: Sole Rolls & Inside Taps
drills.description: Stationary and moving touches using sole rolls, inside-outside touches and toe taps. Foundation routine for close control, performed in a small grid per player.
coaching_points: Keep head up between touches
Light, frequent touches - ball stays within one step
Work both feet equally

rubric.description: Correct body shape and execution of the core technique
Repeats the technique accurately across reps, both feet where required
Works at match-like tempo and focus throughout

drills.name: Ball Mastery: V-Pulls & L-Turns
drills.description: Turning repertoire using V-pulls and L-turns to change direction away from imaginary pressure.

Accelerate out of the turn
Turn both directions equally

rubric.description: Correct body shape and execution of the core technique
